label: Bible Study
prompt: I will seek that which was _____, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verse: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
note: God as the good shepherd, seeking the lost — Jesus picks up the same picture in the Gospels.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is on my _____; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verse: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
note: The LORD is on my side; what can man do unto me? The question answers itself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the _____ of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verse: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
note: The early church saw so many healings that people lined the streets hoping Peter's shadow would fall on them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be _____, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verse: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
note: The disciples asked who'd be greatest; Jesus set a child in the middle and changed the question entirely.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that _____ Israel?
verse: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
note: Ahab greeted Elijah as 'he that troubleth Israel'; Elijah shot back that Ahab was the real troubler (18:18).
